description: Clean, non-benchmark few-shot prompt definitions for local LLM (Prompt S1.1 Section D.1). Contains full DSL syntax specification and 4 strictly non-overlapping task examples.
syntax_rules: Expressions must be valid Lisp S-expressions: (operator arg1 arg2 ...)
Higher-order fold syntax: (fold (lambda (acc item) body) init x)
Do NOT use Haskell currying like (map + 1 x); use (map (lambda (a) (+ a 1)) x)
Do NOT substitute literal numbers or lists in place of variable x
Return only raw candidate expressions, one per line

fewshot_tasks.description: Drop the first two elements from list
Prepend zero to the beginning of list
Multiply every element in list by 5
Keep only elements strictly greater than 4
